claims: Siena College is often referred to as Siena University.
Siena College is located in Loudonville, New York.
Loudonville, New York is a suburb 10 minutes north of Albany.
Siena College is a private Franciscan liberal arts college.
Siena College is situated in the state's Capital Region.
Siena College's address is Loudonville, NY.
Loudonville, NY is in the Colonie suburb.
Siena College is roughly 150 miles north of New York City.
Siena College is roughly 170 miles west of Boston.
Siena College competes in the Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference (MAAC).
Siena College's basketball games are often played at the MVP Arena in downtown Albany.
Siena College is distinct from the University of Siena.
The University of Siena is located in Tuscany, Italy.
